name: metrics_votor
description: Metrics of one votor tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned to its CPU

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

vote.description: Datagram carried a vote and was handed to vote rx

cert.description: Datagram carried a cert and was handed to cert rx

not_ready.description: Datagram arrived before the votor tile was initialized

too_small.description: Datagram was too small to hold a version and a tag

unknown_tag.description: Datagram tag was neither a vote nor a cert

not_admitted.description: Datagram arrived on a connection not yet admitted, or already closed

success.description: Vote was handed to the pool and accepted

bad_size.description: Vote was truncated or had trailing bytes

bad_encoding.description: Vote had an invalid version, tag, or signature encoding

unknown_signer.description: Sending connection had no authenticated identity

not_peer.description: Sender was not in the peer set

banned.description: Sender is banned for a failed signature verification

slot_out_of_range.description: Vote slot was either too old or too far in the future

signature_failed.description: Vote signature was the identity point

unranked.description: Sender was not a ranked validator in the vote slot's epoch

shred_version_mismatched.description: Vote was for a different shred version

duplicate.description: Voter had already cast this vote

success.description: Cert was handed to the pool and accepted

bad_size.description: Cert was truncated or had trailing bytes

bad_encoding.description: Cert had an invalid version, tag, bitmap, or signature encoding

shred_version_mismatched.description: Cert was for a different shred version

unknown_signer.description: Sending connection had no authenticated identity

not_peer.description: Sender was not in the peer set

unranked.description: Sender was not a ranked validator in the cert slot's epoch

slot_out_of_range.description: Cert slot was either too old or too far in the future

duplicate.description: Cert was already in the pool

signature_failed.description: Cert failed the stake threshold or the aggregate signature check

banned.description: Sender is banned for a failed signature verification

voting_slot_used.description: Slots tracked by the voting state machine

voting_slot_free.description: Free entries in the voting state machine's slot table

highest_final_cert_slot.description: Highest slot with a final or fast-final cert seen by votor, 0 if none

pool_slot_used.description: Slots tracked by the vote and cert pool

pool_slot_free.description: Free entries in the vote and cert pool's slot table

highest_pool_finalized_slot.description: Highest slot the pool has finalized (slow-final also needs the slot notarized), 0 if none

rank.description: Rank of this validator in the current epoch (0 is the highest rank), ULONG_MAX if unranked (unstaked)

peer_conn_open.description: Peers with an open outbound connection; replaced by ClientConnUsed

vote_history_file_written.description: Times the vote history file was written

vote_history_file_slot.description: Root of the last written vote history file, which votor waits to vote past, 0 if not written yet

vote_history_file_size_bytes.description: Size of the last written vote history file

vote_history_file_skipped.description: Vote history writes skipped because the history was too large; the file is emptied until it fits

bls_signature_checked.description: Aggregate BLS signature checks of votes, certificates and reward certificates; a search for bad signers counts once

wait_to_vote_slot.description: First slot votor may vote in, past the vote history file and the votes it sent

leader_window_superseded.description: Leader windows given up because certificates already let a later window start, eg. while catching up after a restart

cert_tx_unstaked_skipped.description: Certificates and standstill votes not sent because we are not staked in their epoch

client_pkt_rx.description: UDP datagrams received (one may carry several coalesced QUIC packets)

client_pkt_rx_bytes.description: Bytes of UDP datagrams received, including Ethernet, IPv4 and UDP headers

client_pkt_tx_bytes.description: Bytes of UDP datagrams sent, including Ethernet, IPv4 and UDP headers

client_conn_used.description: Connection slots in use, by state; sum + ConnFree = ConnCapacity

client_conn_no_slot_rejected.description: Connections that failed to create due to lack of slots

client_conn_retry_rejected.description: Retries rejected: an invalid or expired token as server, a late or invalid Retry packet as client

client_pkt_decrypt_failed.description: Packets that failed decryption, by encryption level

client_pkt_no_key_dropped.description: Packets dropped because the decryption key was missing, by encryption level

duplicate.description: Packet number already received or too old

client_pkt_no_conn_dropped.description: Packets with an unknown connection ID, by packet type

client_pkt_retransmitted.description: QUIC packets retransmitted, by encryption level

client_handshake_pool_full_rejected.description: Handshakes dropped due to alloc fail

client_frame_rx.description: QUIC frames received, by frame type

client_frame_parse_failed.description: QUIC frames that failed to parse

client_pkt_meta_acquire_attempted.description: Attempts to acquire packet metadata for transmission, by result

conn_limit.description: Connection reached its in-flight frame limit

client_pkt_ack_processed.description: Received packets processed for acknowledgement, by result

no_pkt_number.description: Packet had no packet number to acknowledge

client_service_duration_nanos.description: Duration of one fd_quic_service call that processed a due connection timer

client_pkt_rx_duration_nanos.description: Duration of processing one received packet

server_pkt_rx.description: UDP datagrams received (one may carry several coalesced QUIC packets)

server_pkt_rx_bytes.description: Bytes of UDP datagrams received, including Ethernet, IPv4 and UDP headers

server_pkt_tx_bytes.description: Bytes of UDP datagrams sent, including Ethernet, IPv4 and UDP headers

server_conn_used.description: Connection slots in use, by state; sum + ConnFree = ConnCapacity

server_conn_no_slot_rejected.description: Connections that failed to create due to lack of slots

server_conn_retry_rejected.description: Retries rejected: an invalid or expired token as server, a late or invalid Retry packet as client

server_pkt_decrypt_failed.description: Packets that failed decryption, by encryption level

server_pkt_no_key_dropped.description: Packets dropped because the decryption key was missing, by encryption level

duplicate.description: Packet number already received or too old

server_pkt_no_conn_dropped.description: Packets with an unknown connection ID, by packet type

server_pkt_retransmitted.description: QUIC packets retransmitted, by encryption level

server_handshake_pool_full_rejected.description: Handshakes dropped due to alloc fail

server_frame_rx.description: QUIC frames received, by frame type

server_frame_parse_failed.description: QUIC frames that failed to parse

server_pkt_meta_acquire_attempted.description: Attempts to acquire packet metadata for transmission, by result

conn_limit.description: Connection reached its in-flight frame limit

server_pkt_ack_processed.description: Received packets processed for acknowledgement, by result

no_pkt_number.description: Packet had no packet number to acknowledge

server_service_duration_nanos.description: Duration of one fd_quic_service call that processed a due connection timer

server_pkt_rx_duration_nanos.description: Duration of processing one received packet

server_conn_retry_expired_rejected.description: Initials with an expired Retry token, also counted in ServerConnRetryRejected. Each gets an INVALID_TOKEN close so the client reconnects

server_handshake_pkt_dropped.description: Connection setup packets from peers dropped before processing, because vote traffic kept the tile busy for too long or the identity was being switched. Peers retry, but sustained growth means new connections are being delayed
